headerDisplay:
TTLock Access Code Plugin.

Follow the [README](https://github.com/ZeliardM/homebridge-ttlock-accesscode/blob/latest/README.md) for configuration instructions and then click "Save" to get started.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Client ID for TTLock Cloud API.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Client Secret for TTLock Cloud API.

totalApiCallsPerMonth.title: Total API Calls Per Month
totalApiCallsPerMonth.description: Total number of TTLock API calls allowed per month (used to automatically adjust polling).

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check device status in the background (seconds)

discoveryPollingInterval.title: Discovery Polling Interval (hours)
discoveryPollingInterval.description: How often to discover new devices in the background (hours)

offlineInterval.title: Offline Interval (days)
offlineInterval.description: How often to remove offline devices in the background (days)

waitTimeUpdate.title: Wait Time Update (milliseconds)
waitTimeUpdate.description: The time to wait to combine similar commands for a device before sending a command to a device (milliseconds). Default: 100.

layout.title: Advanced Settings (Optional)
layout.description: Don't change these, unless you understand what you're doing.
